name: Unitas Gold
oneLiner: xGLD is Unitas’s XAUt-backed gold strategy position, earning NAV growth from borrowed USDT strategies with whitelisted redemption into XAUt.
collateral: XAUt collateral supporting USDT borrowing through BYBIT Stake & Borrow and a basket of delta-neutral strategies; OES mirrors collateral for exchange execution.
pegMechanism: Transferable Unitas strategy position whose NAV reflects XAUt and net strategy returns. Whitelisted users mint and redeem on BNB Chain; redemption releases XAUt after a 7-day cooldown and charges 0.1%. Base holders bridge to BNB Chain. Regular users rely on swaps.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact XGLD on BNB Chain 0xe60106a5cab7e7c64830919d36ab20caaf50ac91 and Base 0xea953ea6634d55dac6697c436b1e81a679db5882 is a transferable operational claim on an XAUt-backed leveraged strategy position, not a fixed-ounce direct commodity claim. Issuer documents XAUt collateral, borrowed USDT and NAV appreciation; both deployments return XGLD and 6 decimals. This intentionally departs from the parent commodity-claim archetype.

sources.label: Unitas XGLD claim, strategy and deployments

parentBackingInheritance.rationale: The borrowed USDT strategy book and debt encumbrance are not quantitatively disclosed; no measured net XAUt share supports treating the position as 100% parent backing.

dependencyReview.rationale: The wrapper relationship records direct XAUt exposure, not a measured collateral allocation; borrowing and strategy weights remain undisclosed.

relationships.reason: XAUt is the parent collateral and whitelisted redemption asset.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Borrowed USDT deployed into Unitas delta-neutral strategies

proofOfReserves.provider: Accountable direct-source cryptographic verification dashboard; gross reserves are not independent financial assurance or a fully netted debt reconciliation.

notices.title: Leveraged gold strategy position
notices.message: NAV depends on XAUt and borrowed-USDT strategies. Direct XAUt redemption requires whitelisting and a 7-day cooldown; full debt and custody allocation are not disclosed.
